source.title: Duskwood Mission V: Worgen Intelligence
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Rotting Orchard. Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Dorilar there and return to me.
source.objective: Gather intelligence from Dreamwarden Dorilar in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion in the barn at the Rotting Orchard and return to Field Captain Palandar.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
